task: W05/W08 bounded production passage-selection reachability audit
method: Read-only code and existing receipt/control inspection. No tests, DB, model/provider, network, heldout inspection or gold edits. Same-model engineering review.

finding.classification: Concrete source-derived availability limitation; not newly runtime-reproduced
finding.trigger: Any ordinary structured run whose owned readable extracted evidence totals25or more passages, including the permitted MC-D01 development result with75blocks.
finding.behavior: All readable authorized passages are selected, then the max24 selection validator rejects the entire input as invalid_extraction_selection before assertion-extraction dispatch. Worker terminalizes failed via pendingOrBlocked/unresolved. No supported answer is produced from that evidence set.
finding.notObserved: No silent first24 truncation or published false assertion demonstrated. Later restriction does not lose a ranking contest: the whole input is rejected. Brief preparation and discovery/read work may already have occurred before this gate.

trace.rule: Each extracted block is stored as a separate passage with random UUID and locator/digest; no coalescing.
Select every owned authorized partial-text/full-text passage ORDER BY p.id. No question relevance, document position, list priority, diversity or bounded selection.
Selection must have1..24distinct UUIDs; rejects25+ before loading task/evidence context. Canonical UUID sort stabilizes action identity, not semantic order.
Context independently caps24passages and24000characters per passage. Whole-text input; no prefix truncation.
Manifest pins question/task digests, every selected passage ID/version/digest/access, source handles and assertion/draft digests. It is selected membership metadata, not full-document coverage proof.

Support restores extraction manifest selection through loadAssertionEvidence; writer source context carries same passages and checked assertions, then final writer support restores same evidence. No later full-document passage retrieval occurs on that path.
Counterevidence also reloads all readable authorized passages; crossing24 after challenge reads blocks context rather than dropping old target evidence.
Requested reuse verification restores target selected IDs; source refresh selects all readable passages of refreshed selected sources and explicitly rejects rows>24.

questionAndCorrection: Original question is included in model context but does not affect passage membership. Corrected replacement/span question uses the same production selector after immutable snapshot reuse or fresh discovery/read. Adding a source may raise total above24 even if each individual document fits. No selective dependency/question-sensitive passage traversal exists.

developmentEvidence.interpretation: Actual parser preservation is established by prior receipt. Production reachability inference follows one-block/one-passage plus max24 schema; this review did not execute that full production journey.

existingControls.scope: Wrong task, missing passage and duplicate selection reject before dispatch; invalid_extraction_selection assertion is for duplicates, not25distinct passages.
24001-character passage fails extraction_context_unavailable without provider dispatch; preserves no-prefix-truncation behavior.
Twelve large passages exceed serialized context policy and return model_context_too_large before provider admission.

regressionGap: No explicit25distinct-passage full production worker control found in inspected backend/core tests. A smallest useful future regression would use generic25+block evidence with a late qualifying passage, assert current bounded failure before changing selection, then verify eventual exact selected membership/qualification handling without a fixture-specific selector. Requires separate implementation authorization/scope; no fix made here.
limits: Selection or broader context alone cannot prove model attention, applicability, support correctness or benchmark quality. No new semantic quality conclusion.
